title: Drifter Salt Nic Shot 10ml - 20mg
description: The Drifter Nic Salt Shot is the perfect solution for vapers who want to add nicotine to their favourite shortfill e-liquids. Specially formulated with nicotine salts, this unflavoured shot delivers a smooth throat hit and faster nicotine absorption compared to traditional freebase nicotine. With a balanced 50% VG and 50% PG composition, the Drifter Nic Salt Shot is ideal for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, offering excellent performance in a range of vape kits and pod systems. This 10ml nicotine shot contains 20mg of nicotine and is designed to be blended with 0mg shortfill e-liquids, allowing you to customise your e-liquid to the perfect nicotine strength. To achieve a nicotine strength of 3.3mg, simply add 1 x 20mg Nic Salt Shot to a 50ml shortfill, resulting in a total of 60ml of e-liquid. Alternatively, adding 2 x 20mg nic shots to a 100ml shortfill will give you 120ml of e-liquid at the same 3.3mg nicotine strength. The Drifter Nic Salt Shot is the ideal addition to any vaper’s kit, providing a simple way to enjoy smooth, satisfying nicotine with every puff.
